scope: Source and local macOS CLI/PostgreSQL acceptance; Linux cross-build only; production unchanged

implementation.secrets: JWT 32 random bytes encoded as hex; server.secret_key independent 32 random bytes encoded as Base64
implementation.lifecycle: Persist once; preserve existing/external keys; reject installed missing-key replacement and explicit upgrade initialization
implementation.migration: Ordinary migrate/status do not require runtime JWT or encryption key; no secret generation; database and deployment checks retained
implementation.unchanged_guards: Core, seed, refresh, backup and credential commands retain full configuration validation; explicit upgrade mode retains strict preflight
implementation.configuration: Private YAML preserves comments and values; actual config owner retained; file lock shared by Setup and CLI processes

defects_caught_during_validation: Make CONFIG paths with spaces must not use make abspath word splitting
Migration must refuse missing explicit config instead of falling back to default database settings
limits: Linux executable was cross-built, not run on a Linux host
Setup regression uses local HTTP/subprocess tests; no new live browser installation
No full production install or upgrade was executed
